checks.title: Optional city tree inventory
checks.rule: A city-specific open tree inventory is optional; no tree counts are inferred when one is absent.
checks.note: No city-specific open tree inventory has been configured. Canopy is derived from global land-cover products instead; tree counts are intentionally not imputed.

checks.title: Latest satellite observations
checks.rule: Both rolling-window composites must be no older than 60 days and cover at least 50.0% of study-area cells.
checks.note: These are the newest cloud-filtered acquisitions available in the provider catalogue, composited over a rolling window; this is near-real-time monitoring, not a live sensor feed. Cloud masking can leave some cells without a value. Pre-monsoon baseline composites remain separate for seasonal consistency.

checks.title: Gridded population over time
checks.rule: A yearly series over about two decades plus an official census anchor.

evidence.read_method: full download (windowed read failed: RasterioIOError('Range downloading not supported by this server!'))

checks.note: The yearly series is WorldPop's modelled product, not a census count. An official census anchor is still to be added; until then the forecast is labelled MODELLED.

checks.title: Existing parks and open space
checks.rule: Enough mapped public green space to compute who already has access.
checks.note: OpenStreetMap is crowd-sourced. Compare against the municipality's own park list before relying on it for decisions.

checks.title: Cost benchmarks
checks.rule: At least 3 usable cost sources for parks or tree planting.
checks.note: Cannot be automated. Person B collects these from municipal budgets, state rate schedules and published studies (Appendix A of the roadmap).
